claim: Reviewed static fact, not a run of vLLM's code: no file of vLLM's serving process (vllm/, csrc/, rust/) names TRANSFORMERS_CACHE; the result lists the files the scan read. The libraries vLLM's requirements/common.txt admit do not read it either: the wheels of transformers 5.16.1, 5.19.0 and 5.23.0 (the ends and a middle of the admitted range, >= 5.16.1, < 5.24.0) and of huggingface_hub 2.0.0 contain no occurrence of the name. A recipe that states it sets a variable of the transformers 4 series, which a serving process on these libraries ignores.
